cast.narrator: Male, 45-60, deep, slow, grave American true-crime documentary narrator. Deadpan. Never jokes; every line delivered with total seriousness.
cast.giga: Male, 25-35, deep, confident, relaxed gym-bro. Smug and sincere.
cast.wojak: Male, 20-30, higher and thinner voice, sad, fragile, on the verge of tears.
cast.whale: Male, 55-70, wealthy, refined, unhurried; speaks like a man reading a statement prepared by lawyers.
cast.pepe: Male, 30-40, fast, intense, conspiratorial; barely containing excitement.
cast.bonk: Male, any age, flat and blunt; one word.
cast.troll: Male, 20-35, gleeful, mischievous, far too pleased with himself.

lines: Diamond Hands Mine. A quiet community, built on a single rule: never sell the game.
On the night of the fourteenth, the Mine led the Grand Final by a mile. Then, with three seconds on the clock... somebody sold.
Within hours, investigators had a list of suspects. It was everyone.
I remember exactly where I was that night. Muscle Beach. Looking at myself.
His alibi was confirmed by a single witness. Himself.
Everyone thinks I did it because I'm crying. I'm always crying. This is just my face.
Detectives noted that he looked guilty. They also noted he has looked like that since two thousand ten.
On the advice of my lawyers, I do not recall owning anything. Ever.
The Whale then bought the police station.
It's all connected. The rubber ducks. The shopping cart. The moon. Wake up!
The witness was cooperative. But unhelpful.
Then, a breakthrough. The match replay.
The replay showed nothing. But it was in black and white, so it felt important.
I did it. I also did the other one. And the next one.
One suspect confessed immediately. Including to crimes that had not happened yet.
And through it all, one alarm kept going off. Nobody knew whose.
After nine months, forty detectives, and one haunted shopping cart, the surrender was traced to a single account. Username: The Narrator.
Yes. That was me. We were down a round, and I had a reservation.
Dinner was at six. Justice was served. With peas.
